summary: ICON plc filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held July 31, 2026. All resolutions were duly passed, including re-election of directors, ratification of auditors' remuneration, share allotment authority, disapplication of pre-emption rights, and authorization for overseas market purchases of shares. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation characteristics. It reflects standard annual meeting procedures for a foreign private issuer, with no strategic transactions, activist campaigns, or material capital events. The voting outcomes are routine and do not indicate any extraordinary corporate action.
